model.name: FeatureManager auto-discovers all Features; MDA feature auto-appears + launchable, membership-gated
model.description: Tron device-QA (2026-07-30): the Model-Driven Code Quality (MDA) feature - built + gated across R32.1-8 (model generation/tree/diagram/edges/puml/re-sync) - does NOT appear in the FeatureManager, so Tron cannot see or launch it. ROOT (measured, PO): FeatureManager.ts:31 hardcodes SEED_FEATURES = [ServerManager 16604eee, FeatureManager 2980b7d9] only; the MDA feature was never registered as an ior:class:Feature unit + listed. THE MISS (own it): Sprint 32 gated the MODEL surface but NO AC covered the FEATUREMANAGER surface (the user-facing entry) - 'functionally complete' was premature; a device-QA regression = a MISSING AC (gate where the AC specifies - the user launcher - not where the code sits). PO REDIRECT (Tron): make it CORRECT-BY-CONSTRUCTION - the FeatureManager DISCOVERS all ior:class:Feature units (DROP the hardcoded SEED_FEATURES list; a listFeatures() scan already exists at FeatureManager.ts:53); creating the MDA Feature unit then AUTO-APPEARS + launches with NO code/list edit (DRY single-source). Each discovered Feature stays membership-gated (R31.8 allowedUsers data-driven gate, like ServerManager) - DISCOVERED != WORLD-VISIBLE. Launch -> the model view (drop -> tree/diagram/edges). NOTE for architect: dropping SEED_FEATURES must preserve the R31.8 first-run owner-membership bootstrap (owner seeded into a feature's allowedUsers) - design the replacement (general first-run seed / creator-sets-allowedUsers); no fork. This is a feature-COMPLETION of the S32 MDA arc (architect -> expert -> tester), gated at the FeatureManager surface.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (device-QA 2026-07-30): "the feature manager does not show the new feature."

discoverySource.note: Device-QA regression = a missing AC: S32 gated the model surface, missed the FeatureManager surface. PO measured the root (FeatureManager.ts:31 hardcoded SEED_FEATURES). PO redirect to correct-by-construction discovery (drop the list, auto-discover). Gate at the FeatureManager surface, not the model API.

model.crossRefNote: R31.8 (a93f5fce) established the ior:class:Feature typed unit + allowedUsers root-of-trust membership gate (ServerManager is the exemplar Feature 16604eee). R32.9 completes the MDA arc by making it a discovered Feature under that same gate - reusing R31.8's data-driven membership, no new gate.

acceptanceCriteria.text: INV-D1 - the FeatureManager DISCOVERS + lists ALL ior:class:Feature units via the EXISTING featuresForToken (server.ts:932, enumerate + per-user membership-filter; listFeatures():53 is the mgmt-view twin). The hardcoded SEED_FEATURES-as-list is DROPPED - what appears is driven by the Feature units on disk, not a code list (correct-by-construction / DRY single-source).

INV-D2 (the crux) - dropping SEED_FEATURES PRESERVES the R31.8 first-run owner-membership bootstrap: bootstrapSeed ENUMERATES every discovered ior:class:Feature unit and seedOwnerInto each one's allowedUsers at boot (NOT the 2 hardcoded features). So a NEW Feature is owner-reachable by construction - the hardcoded 2-feature seed list (the fragility that hid the MDA feature) is gone.

Design-B + INV-D3 - creating the MDA 'Model-Driven Code Quality' ior:class:Feature unit (launchPage '/model', an icon, in PROD scenario/index) makes it AUTO-APPEAR and be LAUNCHABLE in the FeatureManager @390 with NO code/list edit - proving discovery + data-launch.

INV-D3 - launch is DATA-DRIVEN via Feature.launchPage: featuresForToken + renderFeatureGrants use f.launchPage / f.icon, and the hardcoded launch name-ternary (renderFeatureGrants:~1020) is DROPPED. launchPage is backfilled onto the existing Features (ServerManager -> /server-manager, FeatureManager -> /feature-manager) so the ternary fully retires.

INV-D4 (fail-closed guard) - each discovered Feature is membership-gated by R31.8 allowedUsers: DISCOVERED != WORLD-VISIBLE. A non-member does NOT see the MDA feature (per-user featuresForToken filter) AND the gated /model route returns 403 for a non-member (requireFeatureAccess('Model-Driven Code Quality'), reusing R31.8) - only owner/members reach it.

Acceptance is GATED at the FEATUREMANAGER SURFACE @390 (Tron viewport): the MDA feature APPEARS in the FeatureManager list AND LAUNCHES -> the gated /model route -> the R32.5 model view (drop -> tree/diagram/edges), reachable end-to-end - NOT gated at the model API (gate where the AC specifies, the user launcher). A device-QA regression here = a missing AC.

model.acFinalizedNote: 6 ACs FINALIZED to the APPROVED architect design (design-mda-model.md ## R32.9, cdbfc7154; PO 2026-07-30) - adopt-not-invent. Accurate root (smaller than a rebuild): the discovery-LIST + membership guard ALREADY EXIST (featuresForToken:932 enumerates ALL ior:class:Feature + filters by allowedUsers). Only 3 hardcodes to drop: (1) no MDA Feature unit; (2) bootstrapSeed owner-seed hardcoded to 2 features (INV-D2 crux - the fragility); (3) the launch name-ternary (:1020). Design A/B/C/D -> INV-D1 discovery / D2 discovery-seed / D3 data-launch / D4 membership-gate-fail-closed. Anticipated chain (mints on build, IMPL-MINT): UC feature.discover (+ MDA feature.register) -> Class FeatureManager -> Method bootstrapSeed -> Impl -> Test. FEATURE-UNIT (design B, minted at chain time or now): ior:class:Feature, model{name 'Model-Driven Code Quality', icon, allowedUsers:[] (owner seeded at boot by bootstrapSeed/A), launchPage '/model'}, ownerIor -> R31.8 a93f5fce (matching the ServerManager Feature exemplar 16604eee), in PROD scenario/index. SERVER change -> real restart + real-boot verify on ship. GATE at the FeatureManager surface @390, not the model API. This CLOSES the S32 MDA reachability.
